headline: M. Apostolaki: “PASOK proposes 120-installment arrangements, freezing 30% of the debt and a haircut at the end”
summary: PASOK plans to submit a private debt bill proposing 120-instalment arrangements, a freeze on 30% of the debt and a haircut at the end, according to MP Milena Apostolaki.
why: Private debt relief measures affect household credit quality, bank loan recoveries and the broader consumer credit environment in Greece.
